column1: # CADCraft Swedish interface catalog — original translations by the CADCraft contributors.
# License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (the repository LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE).
# Written from CADCraft's English strings; no proprietary translations were copied.
# Clean room: every entry is written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# computing vocabulary. No other product's Swedish interface, string table or terminology
# database was consulted, and no other catalog is used as a source.
# Empty context = ordinary label; @plural = one|other forms with {n}.
# Keep command IDs, keywords, technology/product names and user data unchanged.
# Work in progress: entries are added before the language is registered.
